interpretation: Namespace.membership is an ordered derived union with owned/imported inputs and an additional Type inherited input. Imported contracts drive native input validation and bounded derivation. The handwritten inter-input ordering policy is independently checked against Pilot. Full inheritance and Feature filtering can now derive from canonical graphs asserting all implied relationships are materialized; missing implied computation remains unsupported. Incomplete nonrecursive Type scopes still require inherited snapshots.
pilot_reference: Actual pinned getters run in eight composition controls. Twenty-seven canonical graphs cover seven packages, four typed scopes with inherited snapshots, seven recursive typed scopes and nine complete materialized scopes. Source-Type unions and stored-graph nonmutation are also checked. Two normative disagreements are retained separately in normative-inheritance.json; runtime/source/tool hashes are in union-pilot-controls.json.
